proposed_fixes.title: Refresh Run settings after external file changes
plan: Reproduce an external plugin configuration change while the page is open.
Trace watcher notifications and the IPC-write suppression window.
Schedule a UI-thread reload for external changes without racing an IPC write.
Add regression coverage for external replacement and self-originated writes.

confidence.rationale: The symptom makes this a plausible investigation, but the causal mechanism has not been isolated.

verification: External plugin-setting edits appear without navigating away; self-writes do not cause duplicate reloads.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A watcher callback may miss or suppress an external settings-file update, leaving the view model stale; the failing event path is unknown.
